name: Edge Case Love's Pursuit
source:
Life in 2188 is filled with cutting-edge tech and crime! You've joined D.I.V.A.A., a private agency devoted to helping people deal with cybernetics, AI, and the virtu-net. Although you passion for justice is strong, working as an investigator will expose you to passions of a wholly different kind.

[From in-app description]
translation:
2188年的生活充满了尖端科技和犯罪！你已加入D.I.V.A.A.，这是一家致力于帮助人们处理控制论、人工智能和虚拟网络的私人机构。尽管你对正义有着强烈的热情，但作为调查员的工作会让你接触到完全不同的热情。

[摘自应用内描述]
